name: Question navigator
summary: A numbered jump list for the questions of a quiz or report: one button per question, the current one filled, arrow-key navigation, overflow scroll for long quizzes, and an optional answer mark per number.
highlights: One numbered button per question; the current one is ringed in the brand colour on a tint and carries aria-current
One tab stop: arrow keys, Home and End move focus, Enter or click picks the question
Long lists scroll in the strip with scroll buttons; `wrap` lays them out on lines instead
Optional <aha-answer-mark> per number; the number stays ink
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-question-nav> — for jumping between the questions of a report or a result view. Set `count` and `current` (1-based) and listen for `change`. Pass `results="correct|incorrect||correct"` to show the answer mark beside a number; the mark is the only place answer colour appears (colour rule 11.3), the number stays ink. It reuses the page cell of <aha-pagination> (32px square, radius 8, same hover and focus) but jumps to a known item rather than paging, scrolls instead of eliding with an ellipsis, and carries a per-item result, which pagination, <aha-segmented> (a few mutually exclusive options) and <aha-tabs> (content panels) do not.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render across frameworks. `current` and `count` are attributes; `change` is a composed CustomEvent.

spec.label: Item
spec.value: 32px high, min-width 32px, radius 8px, 1px --aha-border-default border, 600 weight, 6px gap between items

spec.label: Current
spec.value: --aha-color-primary border plus a 1px inner ring on --aha-bg-accent, number stays ink (never a brand fill, so an answer mark never sits on pink), aria-current="page"

spec.label: Result
spec.value: with `results`, a 16px <aha-answer-mark> (decorative) sits 4px after the number; the button's accessible name carries the result

spec.label: Overflow
spec.value: the strip scrolls sideways without a scrollbar; previous / next scroll buttons appear only when it overflows and disable at the ends; the current item is scrolled into view. `wrap` lays items out on several lines

spec.label: Keyboard
spec.value: one tab stop (the current item); ArrowLeft/Up and ArrowRight/Down, Home and End move focus; Enter, Space or a click picks the question

props.name: count
props.desc: How many questions; items are numbered 1 to count

props.name: current
props.desc: The selected question (1-based); reflected when the user picks one

props.name: results
props.desc: Pipe list, one entry per question: correct, incorrect or empty ("correct|incorrect||correct"); adds an answer mark beside the number

props.name: wrap
props.desc: Lay the items out on several lines instead of scrolling one strip

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name of the list; pass a translated string

props.name: item-label
props.desc: Accessible name of each button; {n} is the number

props.name: correct-label / incorrect-label
props.desc: Result words appended to a button's accessible name

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event when a question is picked; value is the 1-based number, index the 0-based position

whenToUse.when: a report, result or review screen where the user jumps to any question by its number, 5 to 100 of them
a long list or table is split into pages of rows
two to five mutually exclusive options that fit in one row, not numbered items
each choice swaps a content panel
the editor's collapsible list of slides with titles and status, not a bare jump list

opinion.note: Show the answer mark only when the screen already reports per-question results; otherwise leave `results` out. Never colour the number or the cell with an answer token: the mark carries the verdict by shape and colour (colour rule 11.3). Keep the cell on the 32px square scale. The current item is a ring on a tint rather than pagination's brand fill so the answer mark's red or green disc never sits on pink.

a11y.role: <nav> named by `label`, containing an ordered list of buttons; the current button has aria-current="page"
a11y.keyboard: roving tabindex: one tab stop; arrows, Home and End move focus; Enter, Space or click picks
a11y.note: `current`, `count`, `results` and the label attributes are observed, so aria follows the attributes. Each button is named "Question 3" or "Question 3, correct".

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The probe is a 12-question list with the 3rd current and the 1st correct.

selfCheck.label: number stays ink; answer colour only on the <aha-answer-mark> disc (colour rule 11.3)
roving tabindex with arrow keys, Home and End; aria-current on the current item
icons by name (system-caret-left/right), answer mark reused, no hand-drawn glyph
persistent nodes; `current` updates in place, the strip does not rebuild
